rules.title: Derive sidereal positions from Swiss Ephemeris
limitations: The result is valid only under the named Calculation Profile and pinned ephemeris data.

rules.title: Assign whole-sign houses and house lords
limitations: Bhava Chalit and cusp-based house judgements require a different Calculation Profile.

rules.title: Derive divisional charts using the profile-pinned traditional Parashara methods
limitations: Compatibility is asserted only for the per-varga PyJHora methods declared by the profile.
D2 uses Traditional Parashara Hora (PyJHora method 2); the remaining supported PyJHora vargas use their factor-specific method 1.
Calculation assurance and birth-input stability are independent axes; non-D1 varga calculation confidence remains corroborated until an independent external snapshot matches the active chart exactly.

rules.title: Derive functional house-ownership roles without benefic labels
limitations: The fact records ownership classes; lineage-specific benefic or malefic labels remain judgement rules.

rules.title: Trace each graha through sign dispositors to a terminal or mutual loop
limitations: The chain is structural evidence and does not by itself assign a life outcome.

rules.title: Derive sign dignity and Panchadha Maitri relationship
limitations: The baseline emits dignity only for the seven classical grahas; Rahu and Ketu are excluded.
Special sign status and Panchadha Maitri are preserved as separate evidence; effective is the explicit precedence view used by downstream presentation.
Degree-sensitive Moolatrikona boundaries are not emitted until an edition-pinned boundary table and independent fixtures are available.
The mathematical sign and Panchadha derivation is source-pinned and boundary-tested, but its automatic supportive or challenging use remains withheld pending professional judgement fixtures.
Panchadha relationship is capacity evidence and does not independently determine an outcome.

rules.title: Derive Shadbala through the VedicDust PyJHora compatibility adapter
limitations: The adapter includes product-owned compatibility patches and same-provider regression fixtures.
Independent JHora desktop golden fixtures are required before promoting this rule to validated.

rules.title: Derive Bhinnashtakavarga and Sarvashtakavarga through PyJHora
limitations: Interpretive thresholds are separate judgement rules and are not defined here.

rules.title: Derive Parashari graha drishti contacts
limitations: Node aspects are excluded from the baseline; degree separation is recorded numerically without an automatic strength grade.

rules.title: Derive same-sign graha conjunction contacts
limitations: The baseline records same-sign contact and numerical degree separation without importing Western orb doctrine or assigning a directional judgement.

rules.title: Derive same-sign kendra-trikona lord associations
limitations: This rule records only a same-sign association between declared kendra and trikona lords.
It does not grade cancellation, affliction, strength, exact fruition, or timing.

rules.title: Derive exact D1 house-lord exchanges
limitations: This rule records only the exact mutual placement of two D1 house lords in each other's houses.
It does not classify the exchange as favorable or unfavorable, grade participating grahas, or infer timing.

rules.title: Derive the complete Gaja-Kesari structural conditions
limitations: The fact is emitted only when all three published structural conditions are present: Jupiter is in a quadrant from Moon, a qualified natural benefic conjoins or aspects Jupiter, and Jupiter is neither debilitated, combust, nor in a natural enemy's sign.
The published natural-benefic list is applied literally; Saturn is not counted on either side of Mercury's companion majority because the cited passage does not classify Saturn there.
This rule recognizes structure only. It does not assert fame, wealth, character, magnitude, cancellation, fruition, or timing.

rules.title: Classify combustion under explicit profile thresholds
limitations: Combustion uses explicit direct and retrograde angular thresholds declared by the VedicDust profile.
Automatic supportive or challenging interpretation remains withheld until the threshold table and judgement use have edition-pinned sources and professional fixtures.

rules.title: Record occupancy of each graha's full directional-strength house
limitations: This is a boolean full-strength-house marker, not a complete Digbala calculation in shashtiamsas.

rules.title: Derive D1-D9 same-sign Vargottama state
limitations: The rule records exact D1-D9 sign equality for Lagna and the nine grahas only; any strength interpretation requires a separate judgement rule.

rules.title: Rank seven classical grahas into the declared 7K Chara Karaka scheme
limitations: The profile uses the seven-graha scheme; roles whose degrees are indistinguishable at the six-decimal evidence precision are withheld rather than resolved by input order.
Cross-lineage alternatives require explicit fixtures before promotion.

rules.title: Derive Arudha Lagna and Upapada Lagna points
limitations: Co-lord and lineage-specific exception settings are not represented by the baseline implementation.

rules.title: Derive waxing or waning lunar hemicycle from Sun-Moon separation
limitations: This is a geometric waxing/waning classification, not a complete Tithi or Paksha interpretation.

rules.title: Derive Bhava Bala through the PyJHora compatibility adapter
limitations: Bhava Bala requires independent JHora golden-reference fixtures before promotion to validated.

rules.title: Derive declared special Lagnas through the PyJHora compatibility adapter
limitations: Each special Lagna algorithm and provider coordinate convention requires independent golden-reference fixtures before promotion.

rules.title: Derive Pancha and Dwadasha Vargeeya Bala through the PyJHora compatibility adapter
limitations: Vargeeya Bala requires independent JHora golden-reference fixtures before promotion to validated.

rules.title: Derive reproducible sidereal transit positions
limitations: This rule emits only absolute sidereal position, speed, and retrograde state at the explicit UTC instant; natal-house placement and interpretation are separate rules.

rules.title: Map a sidereal transit position into the natal whole-sign house frame
limitations: The emitted house is relative to the natal whole-sign Lagna and must be withheld whenever that Lagna is unstable; it does not itself assign an event meaning.

rules.title: Classify Saturn transit relative to the natal Moon sign
limitations: The phase label is a sign-level classification only; it does not predict an event or assign severity.

rules.title: Derive Saturn-Jupiter whole-sign transit intersections
limitations: The rule records shared whole-sign occupancy or graha-drishti targets; activation and event interpretation require separate judgement rules.

rules.title: Derive Vimshottari periods through PyJHora
limitations: Exact local civil-time boundaries preserve PyJHora output with the fixed UTC offset used by the calculation; they still require an independent JHora desktop corpus before cross-software equivalence is claimed.
Period interpretation requires separate promise, capacity, and activation rules.

rules.title: Describe Lagna, Sun, and Moon as the D1 reference-point triad
limitations: The rule exposes the three reference points as inspectable chart structure; it does not assign personality traits or event direction.
Lagna, Sun, and Moon must remain separately traceable to their D1 position facts.

rules.title: Describe an anchor-house lord and its placement as a distinct method
limitations: This rule records the lord-placement method separately; it does not assign an automatic supportive or challenging result.
Domain synthesis and directional interpretation still require independent professional fixtures.

rules.title: Describe anchor-house occupants as a distinct method
limitations: Occupancy is preserved as one structural method and cannot determine a domain outcome by itself.

rules.title: Describe declared Parashari graha drishti as a distinct method
limitations: The rule records declared sign-based graha drishti without importing an undeclared degree-orb policy.
An aspect remains context-only until a separately validated interpretation rule permits direction.

rules.title: Describe an eligible domain varga as a distinct confirming method
limitations: A varga may confirm only the domain declared by the active varga policy and only when birth-time sensitivity permits it.
This rule cannot create a promise absent from D1 or release direction by itself.

rules.title: Describe same-sign and kendra-trikona associations as a distinct method
limitations: The engine records the structural association but does not turn one combination into an automatic Raja Yoga result or life prediction.

rules.title: Describe an exact D1 house-lord exchange as a distinct method
limitations: The exchange is descriptive context until a narrower domain rule evaluates the involved houses, grahas, dignity, affliction, and timing with independent professional review.

rules.title: Describe a topic's natural significators as a distinct method
limitations: The rule identifies the declared natural significators used for a topic and records their available condition evidence.
A natural significator cannot replace the topic house, create a promise, or assign a supportive or challenging result by itself.

rules.title: Describe a complete Gaja-Kesari structure without promising outcomes
limitations: A detected Yoga is one chart structure, not an independent life verdict.
No fame, wealth, moral, social-status, magnitude, or timing statement is permitted without broader chart synthesis and professional validation.

rules.title: Describe an anchor lord's dispositor path as a distinct method
limitations: The path records which dispositors condition an anchor lord; it does not transfer every dispositor result to the topic automatically.
Loops, terminal ownership, and Dasha influence remain structural context until a narrower source-pinned synthesis rule is professionally reviewed.

rules.title: Describe Sarvashtakavarga structural bands without automatic direction
limitations: The 30-or-more and 26-or-fewer bands are versioned product thresholds, not a universal classical rule.
This rule may describe relative capacity but cannot assign a supportive or challenging verdict until edition-pinned sources and professional fixtures validate the interpretation.

rules.title: Describe D1 house-lord dignity without automatic direction
limitations: The cited source supports sign dignity and Panchadha Maitri as structural condition; this rule preserves that condition without converting it into a domain verdict.
Supportive or challenging synthesis requires a separately reviewed directional rule and cannot be inferred from the label alone.

rules.title: Describe Shadbala percentage bands without automatic direction
limitations: The 120 percent and 90 percent bands are versioned product thresholds and remain descriptive until independently validated.

rules.title: Describe combustion state without automatic domain direction
limitations: Combustion state alone cannot establish a domain outcome; interpretation remains descriptive pending edition-pinned validation.

rules.title: Rank birth-time candidates against dated life-event evidence
limitations: Varga domain selection follows the edition-pinned source; event-house and karaka mappings plus component weights remain explicit product hypotheses, not a universal classical formula.
A stable period lord may activate a mapped D1 house by ownership, occupancy, declared Parashari graha drishti, or natural-karaka role; correlated dimensions still contribute only one level weight.
A relevant varga contributes once only when a dated event's period lord owns or occupies one of that varga's mapped domain houses.
The score ranks candidate intervals and cannot prove a birth time or prove that astrology caused an event.
Year-only and month-only events remain uncertainty intervals. Only Dasha levels stable across the sampled start, midpoint, and end may contribute; no sampled instant is treated as the event time.
Year-only events cannot contribute double-transit support. Month- and day-level events contribute only when the mapped activation remains present at every interval sample.
Every event sample must resolve a complete MD/AD/PD hierarchy; a partial provider result fails candidate scoring instead of silently weakening one candidate.
Candidate ranking uses calibration events only. One score-blind reserved event tests the selected candidate or equivalence class; Agent-authored testimony cannot change candidate rank.

Automatic selection requires at least two calibration events from at least two distinct mapped life domains. Repeated events from one domain may remain context but cannot manufacture independent breadth.

rules.title: A varga confirms rather than creates natal promise
limitations: This is a product evidence policy, not a quoted classical verse.

rules.title: Timing requires natal promise and capacity
limitations: The runtime must separately require an exact eligible Vimshottari period before enabling timing.
This controls report certainty; it does not assert event causation.

rules.title: D60 requires a stable high-confidence birth interval
limitations: The source establishes D60 sensitivity and fine-rectification use; the exact eligibility threshold is a VedicDust product gate that requires empirical calibration.

rules.title: Integrate Lagna, luminaries, first-house governance, and capacity
limitations: D1's foundational scope is source-pinned; the integration policy and capacity thresholds remain product hypotheses, not a single classical aphorism.

rules.title: Synthesize identity and agency from D1 promise and capacity
limitations: D1 and D9 domain selection is source-pinned; anchor-house synthesis remains a product hypothesis.
D9 may confirm maturation but cannot create a D1 identity promise.

rules.title: Synthesize career promise with eligible D10 confirmation
limitations: D10's career scope is source-pinned; anchor-house synthesis remains a product hypothesis.
D10 is confirmation-only and must be withheld when birth-time confidence makes it ineligible.

rules.title: Synthesize resources from D1 with eligible D2 and D4 confirmation
limitations: D2 and D4 domain selection is source-pinned; anchor-house synthesis remains a product hypothesis.
This rule supports tendencies and conditions, not promised financial outcomes.

rules.title: Synthesize partnership promise with eligible D9 confirmation
limitations: D9's marriage and interaction scope is source-pinned; anchor-house synthesis remains a product hypothesis.
D9 confirms relationship maturation; it does not independently promise marriage.

rules.title: Synthesize home and rootedness with eligible D4 confirmation
limitations: D4's residence and property scope is source-pinned; anchor-house synthesis remains a product hypothesis.
Property outcomes require non-astrological financial and legal due diligence.

rules.title: Synthesize learning and mastery with eligible D24 confirmation
limitations: D24's education scope is source-pinned; anchor-house synthesis remains a product hypothesis.
D24 is highly time-sensitive and may only corroborate when eligible.

rules.title: Synthesize children and stewardship with eligible D7 confirmation
limitations: D7's children scope is source-pinned; anchor-house synthesis remains a product hypothesis.
This rule cannot diagnose fertility or guarantee childbirth.

rules.title: Synthesize vitality and strain patterns with eligible D30 confirmation
limitations: D30's adversity and selected health-trouble scope is source-pinned; anchor-house synthesis remains a product hypothesis.
Only general wellbeing patterns are permitted; medical diagnosis and treatment advice are prohibited.

rules.title: Synthesize meaning and practice with eligible D9 and D20 confirmation
limitations: D9 and D20 domain selection is source-pinned; anchor-house synthesis remains a product hypothesis.
D20 is confirmation-only and cannot establish spiritual attainment.

rules.title: Synthesize family and lineage with eligible D12 confirmation
limitations: D12's parental and family-lineage scope is source-pinned; anchor-house synthesis remains a product hypothesis.
Family members' motives or diagnoses cannot be inferred from the subject's chart.

rules.title: Activate an established promise through exact Vimshottari periods
limitations: The runtime binds the conclusion to one exact Antardasha whose Antardasha lord owns, occupies, or aspects a topic anchor house.
The cited lesson supports house-lord, occupancy, and graha-drishti relationships during a planet's dasha; VedicDust's exact eligibility and ranking remain a versioned product policy.
P.V.R. Narasimha Rao's separate D60 transit principle is research under a different ayanamsa and node profile, so it is not enabled by this rule.
Timing describes activation conditions and ranges, never guaranteed events.
